text: SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(fgm) * 1.0 / SUM(fga) AS fg_pct, SUM(fga) AS attempts FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats" WHERE game_date >= '2017-01-01' AND game_date < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY player_id, player_name HAVING SUM(fga) >= 100 ORDER BY fg_pct DESC, player_name ASC LIMIT 10
